A little closer to the outdoors.

Choose from a variety of room styles throughout the property. Many include private exterior entrances, a private bathroom, Smart TV, microwave, and mini fridge. Amenities and bedding vary by building.

✧ Varied room layouts✧ Options for families & groups✧ Lakeside and central locations

Jacobs & Cedar

Rooms with separate exterior entrances in quieter settings near the lake.

Bergers

Nearby rooms with shared outdoor gathering space, ideal for friends and families traveling together.

The Guest House

Six rooms with private exterior entrances, centrally located near the Welcome Center.

Miller Lodge & Dolan Dorms

Flexible lodging for groups. Miller room layouts vary; Dolan features bunk rooms and shared bathrooms. Contact us about bedding and linens.
